Dhaka–Chattogram corridor

About this place

The bridge connects the Meghna riverbanks on the Dhaka–Chattogram route. For Gazaria, the approaches show where older ferry routes and newer highway connections meet. The district’s eastern waterways also support fishing, landing points and goods movement.

Use a public approach or riverbank viewpoint and keep clear of highway traffic.
